questions.question: If a positive integer N is divided by 7, the remainder is 3. Which of the following numbers yields a remainder of 0 when it is divided by 7?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Dividend = Divisor x Quotient + Remainder 

Let the quotient be q 

Divisor = 7, Remainder = 3

Dividend = Divisor x Quotient + Remainder

⇒ N = 7q + 3 

⇒ N + 4 = 7q + 7 which is divisible by 7

∴ The correct answer is option 3

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__****Hit and trial Method**

**Given:**

A positive integer N is divided by 7, the remainder is 3

**Calculation:**

Let k be any integer.

⇒ n = 7k + 3

By trial and error method

Option 1,

⇒ n + 2 = 7k + 3 + 2

⇒ n + 2 = 7k + 5

When n + 2 is divided by 7, the remainder is 5.

Option 2,

⇒ n + 1 = 7k + 3 + 1

⇒ n + 1 = 7k + 4

When n + 1 is divided by 7, the remainder is 4.

Option 3,

⇒ n + 3 = 7k + 3 + 3

⇒ n + 3 = 7k + 6

When n + 3 is divided by 7, the remainder is 6

Option 4,

⇒ n + 4 = 7k + 3 + 4

⇒ n + 7 = 7k + 7

When n + 5 is divided by 7, the remainder is 0.

**∴ n + 4 yields remainder 0.**

questions.question: If x² - 8x + 1 = 0 , what is the value of x⁸ - 3842x⁴ + 1?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

x2 - 8x + 1 = 0

**Formula used:**

(a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab

**Calculations:**

x2 - 8x + 1 = 0

⇒ x2 + 1 = 8x (dividing x on both sides)

⇒ x + 1/x = 8 (squaring both sides)

⇒ (x + 1/x)² = 8² 

⇒ x2 + 2 + 1/x2 = 64

⇒ x² + 1/x² = 62 (squaring both sides)

⇒ (x2)2 + (1/x2)² = (62)² 

⇒ x4 + 2 + 1/x4 = 3844

⇒ x4 + 1/x4 = 3842

⇒ x8 + 1 = 3842x4 

⇒ x8 - 3842x4 + 1 = 0

**∴ The value of given equation is 0.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__**If x + (1)/(x) = a, then x² + (1)/(x²) = a² - 2

Here, we have x2 - 8x + 1 = 0

⇒ x + (1)/(x) = 8 

⇒ x² + (1)/(x²) = 8² - 2 = 64 - 2 = 62

⇒ x⁴ + (1)/(x⁴) = (62)² - 2 

⇒ x⁴ + (1)/(x⁴) = 3844 - 2 = 3842

⇒ x8 + 1 = 3842x4 

⇒ x8 - 3842x4 + 1 = 0

questions.question: The population of a town is increasing at the rate of 5% per annum. What will be the population of the town on this basis after two years, if the present population is 16000?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Growth Rate = 5% per annum

Time Period = 2 years

Present Population = 16000

**Concept used:**

Final Population = Initial Population(1 + R%)T 

**Calculations:**

Final Population = 16000(1 + 5%)² 

⇒ 16000(1 + 0.05)2 

⇒ 16000 × (1.05)2 

⇒ 16000 × 1.1025 = 17640

**∴ The population of the town after 2 years will be 17640.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__**In this question, we have used the formula for the Population of the town, 

Do not get confused with the formula of compound interest.

If the population decreases, then we will use the - sign in the bracket.

questions.question: A discount of 20% on the marked price of an article is allowed and then the article is sold for ₹1,380. The marked price of the article is _______.
questions.solution:

Selling Price (SP) of the article = Rs. 1380

**Concept used:**

Selling Price = Market Price - Discount

**Calculations:**

Let the market price 'x'

Discount on market price = 20%

Discount = ( x × 20)/100

⇒ 20x/100

⇒ SP = MP - D

⇒ x - (20x/100) = 80x/100

Now according to the question:

⇒ 80x/100 = 1380

⇒ x = 138000/80 = Rs. 1725 

**∴ The marked price of the article is Rs. 1725.**

questions.question: The difference between the compound and the simple interests for 3 years at the rate of 20% per annum is ₹432. What is the principal lent?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The difference between the Compound (CI) and the Simple interests (SI) is ₹432.

Time (T) = 3 years 

The Rate (R) of interest = 20% per annum

**Concept used:**

Compound Interest = P(1 + R%)T 

Simple Interest = (P × R × T)/100

**Calculations:**

According to the question,

CI - SI = Rs. 432

⇒ 432 = [P(1 + 20%)3 - 1] - [(P × 20 × 3)/100]

⇒ 432 = P[(1 + 20%)3 - 1] - P[(20 × 3)/100]

⇒ 432 = P[(1 + 0.20)3] - P[6/10]

⇒ 432 = P[(1.20)3 - 1] - P[3/5]

⇒ 432 = P[1.728 - 1 - 3/5]

⇒ 432 = P[(3.64 - 3)/5]

⇒ 432 = P[0.64/5]

⇒ P = 432/0.128

⇒ P = Rs. 3375

**∴ The principal lent was Rs. 3375.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__**20% = 20/100 = 1/5

Time = 3 years

Hence assume that the Principle is 5³ = 125 Rs. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0233c5f7e079b67dd16fbfd420a805247c384a701540a6be5928465ad0501fbd.png] 

Simple Interest for 3 years = 75 Rs.

Compound Interest for 3 years = 91 Rs.

⇒ 91 - 75 = 16 

Given that, 

⇒ 16 = 432 

⇒ 1 = 432/16 

The principle, 125 

⇒ 125 × 432/16 = 3375 Rs.

 ∴ The principal lent was Rs. 3375.

questions.question: A car covers a certain distance travelling at a speed of 60 km/h and returns to the starting point at a speed of 40 km/h. The average speed of the car for the entire journey is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A car covers a distance at a speed = 60 km/h

Returns to the starting point at a speed of 40 km/h.

**Formula used:**

Average speed = 2ab/(a + b)

a = Speed a object when it goes from A to B.

b = Speed of a object when it returns same place

Formula is only used when the distance travels by all the speed is equal.

**Calculations:**

Average speed = 2(60 × 40)/(60 + 40)

⇒ A = 2 × 2400/100

⇒ A = 4800/100 = 48 km/h

**∴ The average speed of the car for the entire journey is 48km/h.**

questions.question: A solid right-circular cylinder, whose radius of the base is 15 cm and height is 12 cm, is melted and moulded into the solid right-circular cone, whose radius of the base is 24 cm. What will be the height of this cone?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Radius of the base of a cylinder (R) = 15 cm 

Height (H) is 12 cm,

Radius of the base of right-circular cone (r) = 24 cm.

**Formula used:**

Volume of a cylinder = π × radius² × height 

Volume of a cone = (1/3) × π × r² × h

**Calcultions:**

According to the question,

A solid right-circular cylinder is melted and moulded into the solid right-circular cone then

Volume of cylinder = Volume of Cone

⇒ π × (R)² × H = (1/3) × π × r2 × h

⇒ (R)2 × H = (1/3) × r2 × h

⇒ h = ((15)2 × 12 × 3)/(24)² 

⇒ h = (225 × 36)/ 576

⇒ h = 8100/576 = 14.0625 cm

**∴ The height of this cone is 14.0625 cm.**

questions.question: A shopkeeper makes a profit of 12.5% after allowing a discount of 10% on the marked price of an article. Find his profit percentage if the article is sold at the marked price, allowing no discount.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Profit = 12.5%

Discount = 10% 

**Concept used:**

Profit% = [(SP - CP)/CP] × 100

**Calculations:**

Let the Mark up Price be Rs. 100

According to the question,

Selling Price = Mark up Price (1 - D%/100)

⇒ SP = 100 (1 - 10%)

⇒ SP = 100(0.90) = 90 Rs.

Then Profit% = [(90 - CP)/CP] × 100

⇒ (12.5/100)CP = 90 - CP

⇒ CP (1 + 12.5/100) = 90

⇒ CP (112.5/100) = 90

⇒ CP = 9000/112.5 = Rs. 80

Now Profit% when SP = MP = Rs. 100

⇒ Profit% = [(100 - 80)/80] × 100

⇒ Profit% = [20/80] × 100

⇒ Profit% = 1/4 × 100 = 25%

**∴ Profit percentage if the article is sold at the marked price is 25%.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__**Profit = 12.5% = 1/8

Ratio of** **C.P. to S.P. = 8 : 9 ----(1)

Again, Discount% = 10% = 1/10

Ratio of M.P. to S.P. = 10 : 9 ----(2)

Combining the ratio of equations (1) and (2), we get

Ratio of C.P. : S.P. : M.P. = 8 : 9 : 10

So, if the article is sold at M.P., then

Profit = 10 - 8 = 2 units

⇒ Profit % = 2/8 × 100 = 25%

questions.question: With an average speed of 42 km/h, a train reaches its destination in time. If it moves with an average speed of 14 km/h, it is late by 35 minutes. The length of the journey is:

Distance = Speed × Time

Time taken by train at 14 km/h = T + 35 mins = T + 35/60 = T + 7/12

Now the distance of both journey is same then

⇒ 42T = 14 × (12T + 7)/12

⇒ 42T = 7 × (12T + 7)/6

⇒ 252T = 84T + 49

⇒ (252 - 84)T = 49

⇒ T = 49/168 = 7/24 h

⇒ D = 21 × 7/12

⇒ D = 147/12 = 12.25 km

**∴ The length of the journey is 12.25 km. ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**As per the question,

questions.question: A solid cylinder has a radius of 9 cm and a height of 25 cm. What is the ratio of its total surface area to its curved surface area?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A solid cylinder has a radius of 9 cm and a height of 25 cm. 

**Formula used:**

Total surface area of cylinder = 2 × π × r × (r + h) 

Curved surface area of cylinder = 2 × π × r × h

Where, r = radius

h = height

**Calculations:**

According to the question,

⇒ TSA = 2 × π × 9 × (9 + 25)

⇒ TSA = 2 × π × 9 × (9 + 25)

⇒ TSA = 18 × π × 34 = 612π

Now CSA

⇒ CSA = 2 × π × 9 × 25

⇒ CSA = 225 × 2 × π = 450π 

Now TSA : CSA

⇒ TSA : CSA = 612π : 450π

⇒ TSA : CSA = 612 : 450

⇒ TSA : CSA = 34 : 25

**∴ The ratio of its total surface area to its curved surface area is 34 : 25.**

questions.question: The radius of a solid metallic sphere is equal to 15 cm. It is melted and drawn into a long wire of radius 15 mm having uniform cross-section. Find the length of the wire.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Volume of melted Sphere = Volume of cylindrical Wire ⇒ L = Volume of sphere ÷ Area of cross-section.

Radius of wire (r) = 15 mm = 1.5 cm.

L = (4/3 × π × R³) ÷ (π × r²)

L = (4/3 × 15³) ÷ 1.5² = 4500 ÷ 2.25 = 2000 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 2000 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Radius of solid metallic sphere (R) = 15 cm

Radius of wire (r) = 15 mm = 1.5 cm

**Formula Used:**

Volume of Sphere = 4/3 × π × R³

Volume of Cylinder (Wire) = π × r² × L

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8892c46072172945a09617046f096f2d63cee3bdcdbb890154c2f2e077de8214.png] 

**Calculations:**

Since the sphere is melted to form the uniform wire, their volumes must be equal.

⇒ Volume of Sphere = Volume of Wire

⇒ 4/3 × π × R³ = π × r² × L

⇒ 4/3 × 15³ = 1.5² × L

⇒ 4/3 × 3375 = 2.25 × L

⇒ 4500 = 2.25 × L

⇒ L = 4500 ÷ 2.25

⇒ L = 2000 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 2000 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Conservation of Volume

Whenever a solid metallic object is melted and recast into another geometric form, the total volume remains strictly constant assuming no material is lost in the process.

Volume of a Cylinder

A wire is typically considered a very long cylinder. The volume of a solid cylinder of radius r and length (or height) h is given by V = π × r² × h.

Volume of a Sphere

The total internal volume of a solid 3D sphere of given radius R is calculated using the formula V = 4/3 × π × R³.

Units Conversion

It is essential to convert all physical measurements to a common consistent unit before substituting them into equations. For linear length, 1 cm = 10 mm.

questions.question: If a tradesman marks his goods 25% above the cost price and allows his customers a 12% reduction on their bill, then the percentage profit he makes is ______.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Mark up % = 25% of CP

Discount% = 12%

**Concept used:**

Profit% = [(SP - CP)/CP] × 100

**Calculations:**

Let the CP be Rs. 100 then MP = Rs. 125

⇒ SP = 125 (1 - 12%)

⇒ SP = 125 (1 - 0.12)

⇒ SP = 125 (0.88) = Rs. 110

Now Profit%

⇒ Profit% = [(110 - 100)/100] × 100

⇒ Profit% = [10/100] × 100

⇒ Profit% = 10%

**∴ The percentage profit he makes is 10%.**
